name: Pony V6 XL Token Ordering
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Lead Pony V6 XL prompts cleanly with `score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up`, choose `source_realistic` for DSLR photography or `source_anime` for cel art, then place concrete subject, pose, lens, and light tokens in descending priority.
negative_prompt_patch: score_4, score_3, score_2, score_1, watermark, text signature

name: Multi-Turn Character Continuity Lock
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: On follow-ups ('put her in snow', 'make him turn left'), carry forward exact eye color, hair cut, scar/jewelry, and key jacket/armor tags verbatim before swapping setting/lighting/camera tokens.

name: Authentic East Asian Alley Craft
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Include overhead utility powerlines, vending machine cool spill light, damp tiled narrow pavement, warm paper chochin lanterns, and compact kei-truck/scooter scale.

name: European Old-Town Cobblestone
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render damp irregular granite cobbles, patinated green copper mansard roofs, wrought-iron balcony railings, and warm brass interior bistro glow.

name: Monolithic Brutalist Geometry
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Capture timber-formwork board textures poured in raw concrete, stark geometric skylight cuts across walls, minimal moss streaks, and solitary human scale figure.

name: Weathered Mecha & Mechanical Craft
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Specify micro-scratched matte olive/slate armor paint, hydraulic fluid grime near joints, riveted maintenance hatches, amber caution stencils, and massive gantry cranes overhead.

name: Period Textile & Armor Grounding
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe authentic construction: hand-stitched linen seams, tarnished brass buckles, oiled suede mud splash at hem, layered wool weight, and true period tailoring.

name: Tactile Bauhaus & Nordic Minimal
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Highlight honest tactile craft: travertine stone pore grain, warm oiled white oak joints, bouclé wool upholstery, brushed aluminum, and clean directional daylight shadows.

name: Victorian Iron Glasshouse & Flora
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Fill frame with translucent backlit fern fronds, moisture droplets beading on misted iron glass panes, rich dark peat soil, and multi-plane botanical depth.

name: Master Craftsman Workshop Bench
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stage tactile hand tools (`brass vernier calipers, wood planes, oil rags, glass jars, pencil shavings`) warmed by an articulated gooseneck task lamp.

name: Epic Matte-Painting Scale
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use tiny atmospheric human/caravan scale anchors, flock silhouettes, waterfall mist trails, and distinct blue-haze depth separation so structures feel kilometers tall.

name: Surgical Negative Hygiene
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep negative prompts targeted against anatomical deformation and compression clutter without over-penalizing organic film grain, bokeh, or expressive shadows.
negative_prompt_patch: deformed iris, cross-eyed, extra digits, fused fingers, jpeg artifacts, signature
